{{- /* Inline an SVG from the page bundle so its currentColor text and lines follow the theme of the page, which an cannot do. First argument: the SVG file name; optional second argument: a title shown on hover. */ -}} {{- $name := .Get 0 -}} {{- with .Page.Resources.GetMatch $name -}} {{- else -}} {{- errorf "svg shortcode: %q not found in the bundle of %s" $name .Page.File.Path -}} {{- end -}}
